 Translating Local Success into International Growth, Korean Skincare Brand Torriden Expands Global Presence with Products Introduced to American Consumers
 PRESS RELEASE Plentisoft 
 Nov. 19, 2026, 03:00 AM 
 With five consecutive years of Olive Young Awards recognition, substantial success in Korea, and strong international growth, Torriden brings its bestselling DIVE IN Serum to U.S. shoppers ahead of Amazon’s Black Friday and Cyber Monday sales. 
 Seoul, Korea, Republic of, November 19, 2026 -- Korean skincare continues to attract international attention, leaving an increasing number of K-Beauty brands to compete for consumers’ attention with No. 1 rankings, bestselling products, and viral social media campaigns. However, such claims don’t always mean quality, and many consumers have turned to brands that have earned recognition directly from Korean consumers. After amassing a loyal consumer base and a proven track record in Korea, skincare brand Torriden is expanding into international markets.
 Torriden is among the Korean skincare brands that have earned consumer trust in its home market. With five consecutive years of recognition, a flagship serum that has surpassed 22 million bottles in cumulative worldwide sales, and a growing presence in 57 countries, the company is bringing its Korean market success to an international audience.
 “We believe the best skincare begins with understanding your skin. At Torriden, every formula is designed with purpose, delivering what your skin truly needs,” the company’s founders said.
 Korean skincare consumers' recognition of and trust in Torriden had a substantial effect on the company’s growth. Hwahae, a popular Korean beauty platform known for its ingredient-focused reviews and product rankings, played a key role in Torriden’s early success by helping the brand gain visibility through consumer feedback and word-of-mouth.
 The brand has established a consistent record of quality, earning honors at the Olive Young Awards from 2021 to 2025. As one of South Korea’s leading beauty retailers, Olive Young is recognized as a major destination for discovering products popular among Korean consumers. The annual awards offer valuable insight into products gaining attention in the K-Beauty market.
 Torriden’s recent achievements include a number one ranking for its DIVE IN Mask in 2024. The following year, the brand secured three top rankings at the 2025 Olive Young Awards for its DIVE IN Serum, DIVE IN Mask, and SOLID IN Lip Essence, with each product taking the number one position in its award category.
 The DIVE IN Serum has also attracted attention from American beauty publications. In October 2026, NBC Select published an article examining K-Beauty products popular among Korean shoppers. The DIVE IN Serum was featured in the publication’s “Best Serum” selection.
 Torriden’s domestic recognition has accompanied significant international expansion as the company continues to introduce its skincare products to consumers beyond South Korea.
 According to figures provided by the company, Torriden recorded 47.7% year-over-year revenue growth in the first half of 2026, with overseas markets accounting for 62% of total revenue. The international share of revenue reflects the growing importance of overseas consumers to Torriden’s business. Rather than relying exclusively on its established Korean market, the brand is developing a substantial international customer base.
 Torriden is currently expanding its retail and e-commerce distribution channels internationally. The brand has been introduced to many new audiences through retailers such as Sephora and Costco, alongside online shopping outlets like Amazon.
 With Black Friday and Cyber Monday approaching, American shoppers can explore Torriden’s Korean skincare products through Amazon . The promotional shopping period offers consumers a chance to discover the brand’s award-winning products from its expanding skincare portfolio. For shoppers considering a new hydrating serum or looking to explore K-Beauty products recognized in South Korea, Torriden’s Amazon storefront provides a convenient starting point.
 Explore Torriden’s products and Black Friday and Cyber Monday promotional offers through the official Amazon storefront. To learn more about Torriden, visit the official website and follow the brand on Instagram and Facebook.
